newRegression.fixture: Actual createTestDb migrations, createSequencesMethods, createSequenceMethods, activity methods and real launcher/Continue wrapper. Request-side empty domains, request country, workflow engine and run-state lookup are explicit host-side substitutes.
newRegression.failureInjection: Three test-only synthetic SQLite triggers reject processing, start-activity insertion or publication. Deterministic root-call interleavings replace ownership at the mocked create boundary or immediately after the real claim method returns.
coverage: Acquire from failed/completed and clear the old error atomically
Acquire with no activity and from a null owner
Late create response preserves newer processing/failed/completed rows
Fast current failed/completed outcomes survive publication
Claim replacement before the next launcher action preserves the replacement result
Fresh losing CAS has no state/activity change
Foreign organization activity guard and publisher guard
Repeated publication does not mutate the published row
Publication SQL failure propagates after creation without retrigger/fabricated failure
Real Continue switches are not rolled back on a publication miss
